headline: PDS Ltd acquires 100% ownership of its Hong Kong subsidiary DBS Lifestyle Limited
hook: Full consolidation of the Hong Kong unit
summary: PDS Ltd has taken complete control of its Hong Kong-based subsidiary, DBS Lifestyle Limited, by acquiring the remaining stake to bring ownership to 100%. The company operates within the fashion infrastructure and sourcing sector. This buyout allows PDS Ltd to consolidate the subsidiary's financials fully into its group accounts. For Indian retail investors, such consolidation changes the revenue recognition structure for the listed parent entity.
why_it_matters: Subsidiary earnings will now fully consolidate into parent financials.
winners_losers: PDS Ltd gains / no clear losers
